title: Explore in the admin portal: searching logs, the Queries Library and Entity Explorer

logs-purpose.statement: Explore > Logs searches the data collected from connected sources before it is processed and pushed into the data model.

quotes: This helps you to understand the raw data that's pulled from connected sources and subsequently pushed into the data model.
You can search logs to view data collected by the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform) before it's processed and analyzed.
In the left-side navigation, click Logs.
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Explore.

logs-query-builders.statement: The basic query builder (field, operator, value, AND or OR) and the advanced QL-syntax editor are independent of each other even within one query; the selected time frame is not saved with the query.

quotes: Select an operator (e.g., Equals, Contains, Starts With, etc.).
To create an advanced query, you can use QL syntax in the advanced query editor.
The basic query builder and the advanced query editor are completely independent, even when they are within the same query.
The selected time frame is not saved as part of the query, and must be configured for every result.
Select a field or enter a field name manually.
Enter or select the value you want to filter by.
Use AND or OR operators to add conditions to the query.

logs-drawer-actions.statement: In a log's drawer, hovering a field offers Breakdown By Field, Exclude (a Not Equal filter), Add to Search (an equals filter), Add/Remove Column and Copy Value.

quotes: Breakdown By Field: Use the selected field as the breakdown by field in the pie chart pane.
Exclude: Add a Not Equal filter to the query builder
Copy Value: Copy the value of the field.
Add to Search: Add a filter to the basic query builder to return all logs for which the field's value is equal to the value in the current log.
Add/Remove Column: Add or remove a column in the log table.

logs-charts-export.statement: Log results show a Time Series chart of matching log counts over the selected time frame and a pie chart grouped by a chosen Breakdown by field with a chosen number of top values; the table exports to CSV.

quotes: The Time Series chart shows the number of logs (on the y-axis) that match the query conditions
Use the Breakdown by drop-down menu to select the field you want the logs to be grouped in, and the number of top values you want to be presented in the legend.
Click Export as CSV at the top right of the logs table to export the data as a CSV file.
retrieved from your sources within the time frame selected in the time filter.

queries-library-fields.statement: The Queries Library lists each saved query's name, query type (basic or advanced builder), category, description and last update time and user; a modified copy of a query can be saved with Save As New.

quotes: Query Type: Whether the query was built using the basic or advanced query builder.
Updated At: The latest date that the query was saved.
Click Save to override the saved query configuration with the edited version.
Name: The name of the query.
Category: The category of the query, if assigned.
Description: The description of the query.
Updated By: The last person to update the query.
Use the Save As New option to save a modified version of the current query to your library.

queries-library-delete.statement: Deleting a saved query gives no warning and is immediate; deleting a category either removes only the folder or the category with all queries saved to it.

quotes: Deleting a query doesn't trigger a warning message and deletes the query immediately.
Delete only the folder: Delete the category, but not the queries saved to it.
Delete all: Delete the selected category and all queries saved to it.

entity-explorer.statement: Entity Explorer shows all relevant data per entity, both active and inactive, unlike entity-specific views that show active components; Investigate mode shows source fields next to the platform fields and the table exports to CSV.

quotes: Unlike an entity-specific view (e.g., Tickets, Findings, Assets) which displays active components, Entity Explorer displays all relevant information, both active and inactive.
The table displays source fields next to the platform fields.
To export the data as a CSV file, click the Export As CSV icon.
